children: The Zcash ETF announced a 3-for-1 forward share split that will triple outstanding shares and reduce NAV per share proportionately.
Sponsor announced a 3-for-1 forward split for The Zcash ETF, effective prior to market open on Sept. 30, 2026.
Record Date is market close Sept. 28, 2026; shareholders of record will receive two additional shares per share on Payment Date Sept. 29, 2026.
Post-split shares will continue trading on NYSE Arca under ticker ZCSH; CUSIP remains unchanged.
Split expected to decrease price/NAV per share to approximately one-third while leaving total shareholder value unchanged.
